summary: Cango Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a 10-for-1 reverse share consolidation effective July 20, 2026, with trading on a post-consolidation basis starting July 21. The consolidation applies to all Class A and Class B ordinary shares; no fractional shares will be issued—any fractional entitlements will be rounded down and cancelled. Authorized share capital remains $100,000 divided into 100 million ordinary shares. The board determined the ratio under shareholder authorization from the June 24, 2026 EGM. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation. No deal terms apply; the action is purely administrative to meet NYSE listing standards.
